messages:
Samir Khan: FYI -> EuroBank wants an EU-only proof of concept. Requirements: EU-only processing, no telemetry leaving EU, BYO KMS (prefer Azure Key Vault), APAC only for cold DR object storage (no compute). Need presales + legal checklist + a 48h ballpark cost delta.

Clara Diaz: Important: Azure Key Vault direct calls aren't available from hosted. Hosted supports customer-wrapped DEKs (envelope). Dedicated/Private supports direct Azure/KMS calls from compute.

Diego Ruiz: If 'no telemetry leaving EU' is non-negotiable we must either enable hosted telemetry opt-out + subproc addendum or provision Dedicated EU-only (no US analytics). Dedicated has provisioning lead time ~6-9 weeks and infra cost.

Priya Nair: Also confirm whether they allow CDN endpoints in non-EU. We can route CDN edges to EU-only but some global CDNs have control plane outside EU. Legal cares about named subprocessors.

infra-bot: Current subprocessor inventory (filtered): aws-eu-west-1, aws-eu-central-1, redwood-monitoring-eu, redwood-cdn-eu. Note: hosted aggregated analytics pipeline uses us-east-1 by default; opt-out removes that flow. See /ops/subprocessors.

Samir Khan: Can someone draft: 1) short ops routing policy snippet; 2) legal checklist; 3) ballpark pricing (hosted with envelope BYO vs Dedicated EU-only). Need by EOD.

Diego Ruiz: Draft routing policy:
```
tenant: eurobank-poc
processing_region: eu-west-1
control_plane: eu-only (telemetry opt-out requested)
compute_failover: apac-cold-storage-only (manual restore)
subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-west-1, aws-eu-central-1, redwood-cdn-eu]
```

Priya Nair: Legal checklist (short): signed DPA; subprocessor addendum; BYO-KMS attestation; telemetry opt-out acknowledgement; SOC2/SOC3 report request; egress diagram (control plane vs compute). I'll format.

Clara Diaz: Ballpark: hosted + envelope BYO -> ~+15% run-rate premium for tenant pinning + support. Dedicated EU-only -> ~+35-45% run-rate plus one-time provisioning/onboarding $2k-$4k. Exact numbers after tokens/day and peak RPS.

ops-bot: Hosted BYO key flow: DEK wrapping required; audit logs retained 90 days. Dedicated direct-KMS flows can honor customer KMS endpoints when private networking is provisioned.

Samir Khan: Great. I'll send this summary to EuroBank and ask for expected tokens/day, peak RPS, and whether they can accept a telemetry opt-out addendum (faster) or require Dedicated (slower). Will loop Legal. Thanks all :clap:
